description.value: Circle K is a major chain convenience store and gas station on Rutland Rd. N. in Kelowna's east side. It stocks packaged snacks, beverages, and fresh prepared food alongside a roller grill for hot items. Public restrooms are available on-site, making it a functional resupply and rest stop for cyclists moving through the Rutland corridor.

address.value: 1007 Rutland Rd. N., Kelowna, BC V1X 4Y9
